headline: National Bank of Ethiopia Launches Liquidity Tools for Islamic Banks
summary: Ethiopia's central bank established overnight facilities and an interbank market for interest-free banks, with transactions starting at $155,000.
why: Expanding Islamic liquidity instruments helps integrate non-interest banking into Ethiopia's formal financial system.

impacts.name: Ethiopia
impacts.why: Central bank launched dedicated interbank liquidity mechanisms for Islamic lenders.
